notes.title: Sinsations 2: Modern Gods now live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that the sequel to Sinsations is now live on Kickstarter! You can find a link to the Kickstarter below, which includes links to our playable demo!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1660363304/sinsations-2-modern-gods-a-bl-yaoi-visual-novel]Back Sinsations 2: Modern Gods on Kickstarter![/url]

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Kickstater bonus paths for [spoiler]Lucifer[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Chester[/spoiler]. Unlockable and playable from the main menu under Bonus once you have completed the game. This means getting the credits to play and does not require a true ending.
[*] Added associated Galleries for the new bonus paths.
[*] Added new "Skip to next choice" button to UI. This is the button to the far right of the dialog box. This will skip dialog you haven't seen unlike the Fast Foward button, which only skips dialog you have seen.
[*] Removed achievements that are not unlockable in this release to allow for 100% completion of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Strategy Guide Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just dropping a quick announcement. We finished the Official Strategy Guide for Sinsations! You can find it in the Community Hub under Guides. A direct link is also below.

Thank you everyone for your support and please let us know if you run into any discrepancies with the Guide as you play the game. Please note that the Guide was written in the context of the latest update of the game (which just came out today), so if you run into any issues please make sure you're on the latest version. Thanks!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2660083880

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have released a new update to fix some minor issues.

[list]
[*] Minor script updates to make choice text consistent.
[*] Corrected one section of Pride dialog that didn't advance as intended.
[*] Fixed pathing in one Greed ending that showed incorrect dialog.
[*] Added version number to Settings menu to allow for future reference for reporting issues.
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued feedback! We should have a guide available for the game here shortly to coincide with this update.

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 8
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We released a new update today to fix a few issues we encountered through user reports and some further testing/verification.

[list]
[*] Corrected a few achievements not triggering correctly.
[*] Minor script updates to fix audio and dialog not matching.
[/list]

Thank you all for the feedback you provide and we will continue to work on fixing any issues you encounter!
